project_overview: A system for managing police cases with features for registration, investigation, prosecution, and search, along with robust audit and access control mechanisms.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Administrator with privileges to manage user profiles and system configurations

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Law enforcement personnel who investigate and manage cases

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user who may report cases or access limited case information

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff who handle defect reports and enhancement requests

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: External personnel who review system activity and audit trails

actors.name: RecordsStaff
actors.description: Staff responsible for maintaining case records

functions.name: RegisterCase
acceptance_criteria: Case details are captured accurately
Case is assigned a unique identifier
functions.preconditions: User must be authenticated and authorized

functions.name: InvestigateCase
functions.description: Conduct investigation on a registered case
acceptance_criteria: Investigation details are recorded
Case status is updated appropriately

functions.name: ProsecuteCase
acceptance_criteria: Prosecution details are recorded
Case status is updated to reflect prosecution

functions.name: SearchCase
functions.description: Search for cases based on various criteria
acceptance_criteria: Search results are returned within specified time limits
Only cases accessible to user are shown

functions.name: TrackDefect
acceptance_criteria: Defect status is accurately tracked
Users receive alerts on status changes

functions.name: ExportAuditTrail
functions.description: Export audit trail for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit trail is exported without affecting stored data
Exported data is complete and accurate

functions.name: ManageUserProfile
acceptance_criteria: Profiles are created/updated accurately
Only admin users can perform this function

functions.name: ConfigureAccess
acceptance_criteria: Access rights are set correctly
Changes are logged in audit trail

functions.name: LogDefect
acceptance_criteria: Defect is logged with all required details
User receives confirmation

functions.name: GenerateReport
functions.description: Generate reports on defects or cases
acceptance_criteria: Reports are generated accurately
Reports can be filtered by various criteria
functions.preconditions: User must have report generation permissions

constraints.description: Provide detailed context-sensitive help material
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: Provide interface for logging defects
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: Maintain unalterable audit trail
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Track events without manual intervention
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: Allow limiting case access to specified users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Only admin can set up user profiles
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: Perform simple search within 5-8 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: Perform advanced search within 10-15 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: Support multilingual interface
constraints.source_text: The system should support multilingual interface

constraints.description: Use HTTPS as communication protocol
constraints.source_text: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

constraints.description: Prevent SQL injection
constraints.source_text: Prevent SQL Injection Utilize parameterized queries Sanitize the user-inputs

constraints.description: No hard delete, only soft tagging
constraints.source_text: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

constraints.description: Work in offline mode with critical functionality
constraints.source_text: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

constraints.description: Implement using SOA and modular design
constraints.source_text: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

constraints.description: Support selective encryption of stored data
constraints.source_text: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

constraints.description: Ensure secure data transmission with SSL and 2-way digital signatures
constraints.source_text: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

constraints.description: Prevent cross-site scripting
constraints.source_text: Prevent cross-site scripting Validate the incoming data / user request Encode the incoming data / user request

constraints.description: Validate data at client and server
constraints.source_text: Validate the data both at the client and server

constraints.description: Retrieve and display recently accessed cases within 5-8 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: Retrieve and display not recently accessed cases within 20 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: System must be scalable
constraints.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

constraints.description: Design to prevent data loss in case of failure
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

constraints.description: Design for satisfactory performance on low-bandwidth
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

constraints.description: Build on common User Access and Authentication Service
constraints.source_text: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

constraints.description: Support multi-tier authentication
constraints.source_text: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

constraints.description: Support SSL encrypted connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

constraints.description: Support secure VPN connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

constraints.description: Run on multiple browsers
constraints.source_text: The system should run on multiple browsers

constraints.description: Design for browser-based access with minimal client requirements
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

constraints.description: Support multiple types of communication services for remote access
constraints.source_text: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access a case they don't have rights to
exceptions.handling: Log in audit trail and provide appropriate response based on configuration

exceptions.trigger: User searches for a case that doesn't exist or they can't access
exceptions.handling: Return appropriate message without revealing existence of restricted cases

exceptions.trigger: System is operating in offline mode
exceptions.handling: Provide limited functionality with appropriate warnings

non_functional_requirements.description: System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions
High standards of security and access control through prevention of SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and data validation
System must be available during specified hours with minimal planned and unplanned downtime
User interfaces should be intuitive and comply with ISO 9241 standards for accessibility
System must be scalable for use in small or large police stations
Operational data must not be lost in case of equipment or communication network failure
